stories.title: Bitcoin Tests $78.3K Support as Oil Climbs and Correlation Data Splits the Story
stories.summary: Bitcoin is testing key support near $78,300 as US crude oil hit a three-month high, per Cointelegraph. Separately, CryptoSlate reported bitcoin's correlation with the S&P 500 fell to a decade low, though the outlet notes daily price data tells a more complicated story than that headline number suggests. Together the reports leave open whether bitcoin is genuinely decoupling from stocks or just showing noisy short-term readings.
stories.whyItMatters: Support levels and cross-asset correlation shifts shape whether traders treat bitcoin as a distinct asset or still a risk-on proxy tied to equities and commodities.
whatToWatch: Whether the $78.3K support level holds
Further moves in crude oil prices
Next readings on the bitcoin-S&P 500 correlation
questions: Is the correlation drop durable or a short-term statistical artifact?
What is behind the current oil price rally?

stories.title: Block Seeks US Trust Bank Charter for Bitcoin and Stablecoin Services
stories.summary: Jack Dorsey's Block has applied for a US trust bank charter that would let it handle Bitcoin and stablecoin services, according to Cointelegraph. The report did not specify which regulator is reviewing the application or a timeline for a decision.
stories.whyItMatters: A bank charter would give Block a regulated structure for holding crypto assets directly, a path other fintechs are likely watching closely.
whatToWatch: Regulator response to the charter application
Any disclosed timeline for approval
questions: Which agency is reviewing the application?

stories.title: Bitcoin's SOPR Metric Hits Longest Profit Streak of 2026
stories.summary: The Spent Output Profit Ratio, an on-chain metric tracking whether coins move at a profit or loss, has posted its longest run of profit-taking so far in 2026, according to Cointelegraph. New analysis cited in the report pushes back against the idea that bitcoin has entered a bear market.
stories.whyItMatters: On-chain profitability metrics like SOPR feed into how analysts read holder behavior and the broader debate over bitcoin's current trend.
whatToWatch: Whether the profit streak continues or reverses
Further analyst commentary on the bear-market debate
questions: What specific data underlies the pushback against a bear-market call?

stories.title: Bitcoin Holds Near $78,500 as Surging Yen Pressures Risk Assets
stories.summary: Bitcoin is hovering around $78,500 even as a strengthening Japanese yen weighs on global risk assets, CryptoSlate reported. A stronger yen can squeeze carry trades that have helped fund investment flows across markets, including crypto.
stories.whyItMatters: Currency moves like a yen rally can trigger broader risk-asset selloffs, so bitcoin's ability to hold its level under that pressure is a signal traders watch closely.
whatToWatch: Further moves in the Japanese yen
Whether $78,500 holds as a support level
questions: How exposed is crypto to a yen carry-trade unwind compared with equities?

stories.whyItMatters: The bill's fate would help decide how US crypto firms are regulated and which agency holds jurisdiction, a major open question for the industry.

stories.title: Bitcoin Core Lightning Docker Bug Leaves Node Operators Exposed
stories.summary: A bug in Bitcoin Core Lightning's Docker packaging can leave node operators running vulnerable software even while it displays an updated version number, CryptoSlate reported. That mismatch creates a false sense of security about patch status.
stories.whyItMatters: Lightning Network operators rely on accurate version reporting to know they're protected, so a masking bug like this can leave real vulnerabilities unaddressed.
whatToWatch: A fix or patch from Core Lightning maintainers
Guidance issued to affected node operators
questions: Has the underlying vulnerability been exploited?
